records.source: Sometimes those spring petals that float around make my nose drip.$s#$e#I like summer best, myself.
records.translation: 有時春天四處飄散的花瓣會害我流鼻水。$s#$e#我自己最喜歡夏天。

records.source: Hey, you know what? That's exactly the kind of style I've been thinking about... for the band.
records.translation: 嘿，你知道嗎？那正是我一直在考慮的樂團風格。

records.source: Hey, you know what? That's exactly the kind of style I've been thinking about... for the band.
records.translation: 嘿，你知道嗎？那正是我一直在考慮的樂團風格。

records.source: Hey, you know what? That's exactly the kind of style I've been thinking about... for the band.
records.translation: 嘿，你知道嗎？那正是我一直在考慮的樂團風格。

records.source: Hey, you know what? That's exactly the kind of style I've been thinking about... for the band.
records.translation: 嘿，你知道嗎？那正是我一直在考慮的樂團風格。

records.source: Oh, I see.
records.translation: 喔，我明白了。

records.source: My little brother gets so excited for festivals. He's been talking about tomorrow's egg hunt all day.
records.translation: 我弟弟一碰到節慶就興奮極了。他一整天都在談明天的找彩蛋活動。

records.source: Why couldn't the flower dance be today so I could get work off?$s
records.translation: 花舞節為什麼不能辦在今天？這樣我就能放假了。$s

records.source: One time, Gus fell in the river during the Ice Festival. We had to build a huge fire in the saloon to dry him out.#$e#We were all worried we'd never taste his famous spaghetti ever again.
records.translation: 有一年冰雪節，格斯掉進了河裡。我們只好在酒館生起一大堆火，把他烘乾。#$e#大家都擔心再也吃不到他那道著名的義大利麵了。

records.source: Tonight, after everyone is asleep, that weird old man who lives in the woods will set up the haunted maze. He always makes sure no one is around to see him working.
records.translation: 今晚等大家都睡著後，住在森林裡的那位怪老頭會來布置鬧鬼迷宮。他工作時總會確保四下無人。

records.source: I don't have to work tomorrow! I've never been so happy.$h
records.translation: 我明天不用工作！從沒這麼開心過。$h

records.source: The Feast of the Winter Star is supposed to be a time to show gratitude for all the good things in life.#$b#Me? I'm mostly interested in the food. Hehe.$h
records.translation: 冬日星盛宴應該是向人生中所有美好事物表達感謝的日子。#$b#我嗎？我主要對食物有興趣。嘿嘿。$h

records.source: Yeah... That's what happened!
records.translation: 對……事情就是這樣！

records.source: ${He's^She's}$ right... That's what happened.$s
records.translation: ${He's^She's}$說得對……事情就是這樣。$s

records.source: Yeah... That's what happened!
records.translation: 對……事情就是這樣！

records.source: What!? ${He's^She's}$ lying!$a
records.translation: 什麼！？${He's^She's}$在說謊！$a

records.source: Hey, how's it going?#$e#I'm hungry.#$e#See you later.
records.translation: 嘿，最近如何？#$e#我餓了。#$e#待會兒見。

records.source: Have you been to the desert yet?#$e#You can find some interesting things there. Dad took me a couple times when I was younger.
records.translation: 你去過沙漠了嗎？#$e#那裡能找到一些有趣的東西。我小時候爸爸帶我去過幾次。

records.source: There's a little less pollen in the summer... my nose is really happy.
records.translation: 夏天的花粉少一點……我的鼻子可高興了。

records.source: Oh, hi! It's good to see you again.#$e#Goodbye for now.
records.translation: 喔，嗨！很高興又見到你。#$e#先再見啦。

records.source: Hi, @. Do you want to hang out or something?#$e#I'm so energized during summer I hardly have to sleep!
records.translation: 嗨，@。想一起混混時間什麼的嗎？#$e#我在夏天精力旺盛，幾乎不用睡覺！

records.source: Hi. Taking the day off?#$e#Sounds interesting.
records.translation: 嗨。今天休息嗎？#$e#聽起來挺有趣。

records.source: I saw a spider on my ceiling last night. They sure like the warmth.#$e#I hope he didn't crawl into my mouth while I was asleep...$s
records.translation: 昨晚我在天花板上看到一隻蜘蛛。牠們真的很喜歡溫暖的地方。#$e#希望我睡著時，牠沒有爬進嘴裡……$s

records.source: Dad was telling me about our national enemy, the Gotoro Empire... They sound like a ruthless bunch.
records.translation: 爸爸跟我說過我們國家的敵人戈特羅帝國……那些人聽起來非常殘酷。

records.source: Sometimes I can hear my Dad pacing down the hallway at night.$s#$b#...But he won't tell us what's troubling him.
records.translation: 有時晚上能聽見爸爸在走廊上來回踱步。$s#$b#……但他不肯告訴我們有什麼心事。

records.source: You know... I used to live in the city and I have to admit, this place is much nicer in the summer.$h#$e#The city is so hot with all that concrete.
records.translation: 你知道嗎……我以前住在城市裡，但不得不承認，這裡的夏天舒服多了。$h#$e#城市到處都是混凝土，熱得要命。

records.source: When you see hot air balloons drifting over the sea, you'll know that summer's in full swing.
records.translation: 看到熱氣球在海上飄過，就知道夏天正值盛期。

records.source: I like taking walks in the forest this time of year. The temperature is so comfortable.#$e#...$h
records.translation: 每年這個時候，我喜歡去森林散步。氣溫舒服極了。#$e#……$h

records.source: Oh, hi. Are you making friends with anyone in town?#$e#Bye.
records.translation: 喔，嗨。你有和鎮上的人成為朋友嗎？#$e#再見。

records.source: My shoes always seem to wear out this time of year. Look, my toe's poking through!$h#$e#That's what happens when you skateboard too much.
records.translation: 我的鞋每年這時候好像都會穿破。你看，腳趾都露出來了！$h#$e#滑太多滑板就是這種下場。

records.source: I ordered a new pair of shoes online. They're the same style so I know they'll fit right.
records.translation: 我在網路上訂了一雙新鞋。款式和現在這雙一樣，所以肯定合腳。

records.source: I ordered some shoes online more than a week ago! Man, they're really taking a long time.#$e#I guess we must really live in the middle of nowhere.$s
records.translation: 我一個多星期前就在網路上訂鞋了！天啊，真的等好久。#$e#看來我們真的是住在偏僻得要命的地方。$s

records.source: Ah, my feet feel great in these new shoes. They're a little crisp, but they'll break in. Especially after I run through the haunted maze this weekend.$h
records.translation: 啊，穿著這雙新鞋，雙腳舒服極了。雖然還有點硬，但穿久就會合腳。尤其是這週末跑過鬧鬼迷宮之後。$h

records.source: Hi, @. Do you want to hang out or something?#$e#Just stop by whenever you want.
records.translation: 嗨，@。想一起混混時間什麼的嗎？#$e#隨時想來就來吧。

records.source: Hey... something smells good, like pizza.#$e#Do you smell that? Maybe Mom's cooking something.
records.translation: 嘿……有東西聞起來很香，像披薩。#$e#你聞到了嗎？也許媽媽正在煮東西。

records.source: I think my Dad might be coming back next year.#$e#I guess that's kind of soon. Weird.
records.translation: 我想爸爸明年可能會回來。#$e#好像很快就到了。感覺真怪。

records.source: I guess I should start thinking about moving out soon...$s#$e#...But I would miss Mom's fish casserole, so I dunno...$s#$e#I hate making decisions.
records.translation: 我想自己應該開始考慮盡快搬出去了……$s#$e#……但我會想念媽媽的焗烤魚，所以也不知道……$s#$e#我討厭做決定。

records.source: Did you ever notice all the spider webs that appear during the fall?#$e#If you get up early you'll see them covered in dew... like little stars.
records.translation: 你有注意過秋天出現的那些蜘蛛網嗎？#$e#只要早起，就會看到上面覆滿露珠……像一顆顆小星星。

records.source: I used to live in Zuzu City, you know. The biggest difference is the noise. It's never quiet in the city.#$e#There's way more people around you, always. And it's always bright with city lights, even at night.#$e#I guess which setting you like depends on your personality.
records.translation: 你知道嗎，我以前住在祖祖市。最大的差別就是噪音。城市裡從來沒有安靜的時候。#$e#身邊總是有多得多的人。即使到了晚上，城市的燈光也始終明亮。#$e#我想，喜歡哪種環境取決於個性。

records.source: I think I've grown to like the country more than the city.$h#$b#Although I could be biased... for a certain reason.$10#$e#So, how are you doing today?$h
records.translation: 我想自己已經變得比起城市更喜歡鄉下了。$h#$b#不過我也可能不太客觀……因為某個特別的理由。$10#$e#所以，你今天過得如何？$h

records.source: I'm lucky to have the biggest room in the house to myself.#$e#I guess there's advantages to being the oldest child.
records.translation: 我很幸運，可以獨享家裡最大的房間。#$e#看來當家中最大的孩子還是有好處。

records.source: Hmm. I think I was meaning to do something... But I forgot.#$e#This happens to me all the time.
records.translation: 嗯。我好像本來要做某件事……但忘記是什麼了。#$e#這種事總是發生在我身上。

records.source: The first week of fall is already over. Man, that went by fast.$s#$e#Whatever. I'm just happy that you came to visit me!#$e#So do you have anything new to tell me?
records.translation: 秋天的第一週已經結束了。天啊，過得真快。$s#$e#算了。你來看我，我就很開心！#$e#所以，有什麼新鮮事可以告訴我嗎？

records.source: It's hard to have fun on Sunday... I keep thinking about having to go to work tomorrow.$s
records.translation: 星期日很難玩得盡興……我一直想到明天得去上班。$s

records.source: Hi @.#$e#Hmm.. I wonder if I could grow a cactus in my room?
records.translation: 嗨，@。#$e#嗯……不知道能不能在房間裡種仙人掌？

records.source: Everyone's indoors during the winter, so I can play guitar as loud as I want.$h
records.translation: 冬天大家都待在室內，所以我想把吉他彈得多大聲都行。$h

records.source: Hi... Cold, isn't it?
records.translation: 嗨……很冷，對吧？

records.source: Oh, hi! It's good to see you again.#$e#Take it easy.
records.translation: 喔，嗨！很高興又見到你。#$e#放輕鬆。

records.source: Hi, @. Do you want to hang out or something?#$e#Well, it's a good time of year to catch up on all the sleep I've missed.$h
records.translation: 嗨，@。想一起混混時間什麼的嗎？#$e#嗯，每年這個時候很適合把錯過的睡眠全補回來。$h

records.source: $d Joja#I hate working at JojaMart, but how else am I going to make money in this town?|I'm glad I work at the museum now. It's way more interesting than that depressing JojaMart ever was.
records.translation: $d Joja#我討厭在 Joja 超市工作，但在這個鎮上還能怎麼賺錢？|很高興自己現在在博物館工作。那裡比令人鬱悶的 Joja 超市有趣多了。

records.source: I think my Dad is coming back this spring.#$e#It's been 3 years since I've seen him. This is going to be strange.
records.translation: 我想爸爸今年春天就會回來。#$e#已經三年沒見過他了。感覺一定很奇怪。

records.source: Dad's been back for a while now. I guess I'm finally getting used to it.
records.translation: 爸爸已經回來一陣子了。我想自己終於習慣了。

records.source: My Dad is in the military, fighting against the Gotoro Empire. That's why he's not here.#$e#He's coming back soon, though.
records.translation: 爸爸是軍人，正在和戈特羅帝國作戰。所以他不在這裡。#$e#不過他很快就會回來。

records.source: One thing that's nice about winter... all the mosquitos are gone.
records.translation: 冬天有一件好事……所有蚊子都消失了。

records.source: The worst thing about the snow is getting your feet soaked. You're lucky in those thick boots.
records.translation: 下雪最糟的就是雙腳會溼透。你有那雙厚靴子，真幸運。

records.source: I just remembered I need to change the strings on my guitar.#$b#Okay, I'm going to write a note on my wrist so I remember to do it tonight.#$e#I have to make little reminders for myself or else I'll totally forget to do things.$h
records.translation: 我剛想起來該換吉他弦了。#$b#好，我要在手腕上寫張字條，提醒自己今晚去換。#$e#我必須替自己做些小提醒，不然會把該做的事忘得一乾二淨。$h

records.source: It would be fun if we could go sledding, wouldn't it?#$e#I don't think there are any good hills nearby.$s#$e#Plus, I don't have a sled.#$e#So, how have you been doing lately?
records.translation: 如果能一起去滑雪橇，一定很好玩，對吧？#$e#但附近好像沒有適合的山坡。$s#$e#而且我也沒有雪橇。#$e#所以，你最近過得如何？

records.source: Try not to make a mess in the house or my Mom will flip.
records.translation: 盡量別把屋子弄亂，不然媽媽會氣瘋的。
